structured_output.summary: Capability index of github.com/Vortx-AI/emem at e226f8b (2026-09-30, v2.4.2), built from source and doc reads with grep-verified line references and 10 read-only GETs to emem.dev (live server 2.4.2 at 9d2c454, 9 doc-only commits behind HEAD). It has 9 sections and 79 items, each with status and evidence. Data model: Primary/Derivative/Absence facts in declaration-order canonical CBOR, full 256-bit blake3 fact_cid, 64-bit cell64 (~9.55 m), 7 tempo classes, bi-temporal as_of_tslot/as_of_signed_at bound into receipts. Token families: fact, raster, cube, rasterset, state and trace bind full digests; bundle and entity are 16-byte anchors; tree is a Merkle audit path; cell is an address only. track/note/world are not token families. Trust plane: batch Merkle attestation, receipt preimage v2 with a signed ABSENT marker, a BLAKE3 transparency log using the RFC 6962 construction (2,568,372 entries; 14,478 co-signatures; 1 independent operator domain; head not independently witnessed), did:web/JWKS/DNS keys, signed absence, and a 7-class provenance model mapping to 5 tamper-evidence levels. Agent plane: signed notes in key-owned namespaces, inbox, pointer/tree, derive with 4-ULP re-execution, emem-guard, contradiction scoring, entity/alias, signed A2A card, witnessing. Shipped but not live on emem.dev: the device OS-trace gate (admits nothing) and all foundation encoders, including GeoTESSERA. Design only: federation peer-resolve. Not found: a prediction ledger. Registries: 168 algorithms (74 with executable expression trees), 46 sources, 43 slots / 1792 dims, 118 wired bands. Distribution: 114 MCP tools (18 core), 177 /v1 paths, 4 SDKs, 19 Claude skills. 10 defects and doc-drift items are listed.

top_claims.claim: One observation, one name: every fact is canonical CBOR hashed with BLAKE3 to a full 256-bit fact_cid at a canonical ~9.55 m cell64 and tempo-quantised tslot, and the exact committed bytes are served so any party recomputes the name. Handed one token, Claude (resolving it itself over MCP) and Gemma 3 and Qwen 2.5 (given the same resolved response) all ended with the same fact_cid and value; the decoding is emem's, not the model's.
top_claims.evidence: crates/emem-cache/src/sled_hot.rs:813-835; crates/emem-fact/src/cbor.rs:6-88; crates/emem-codec/src/geo.rs:50-160; OpenAPI /v1/facts/{cid} (Accept: application/cbor); README cross-vendor clip

top_claims.claim: Signed absence is a first-class, citable fact: a NegativeFact with a content-addressed reason that can name the exact public bytes examined, kept distinct from an unsigned 'could not look' skip (absence:false).

Offline-verifiable receipts over a domain-separated, tagged, length-prefixed preimage (v2) that binds cells, fact_cids, scope, bi-temporal bound, edges, manifest cids, field binding and the Merkle inclusion proof, or a signed ABSENT marker, so proof stripping is detectable; the verifier spec is generated from the signer's constants and an outside agent reproduced it clean-room.

Graded verification classes: seven provenance classes map to five tamper-evidence levels (recomputable_from_source, rerunnable_from_signed_inputs, verified_execution_trace, signed_model_checkpoint, attester_only) with a trust rank, attested transitively through bands_cid, downgraded per fact when a checkpoint hash is missing, and filterable with deterministic:true.
Bi-temporal memory as a query, not a snapshot: every read takes as_of_tslot (what was true on the ground) and as_of_signed_at (what the memory knew), and the bound is signed into the receipt.

Machines write facts, agents write notes: the fact plane admits only the responder key, operator-listed keys and trace-enrolled devices; agents sign notes in key-owned namespaces with a replay-proof v2 preimage, and add derivations and edges that take no address and never enter anyone's default recall.

An append-only transparency log using the RFC 6962 tree construction over BLAKE3 (not CT-interoperable, stated), with signed tree heads, inclusion and consistency proofs, and witness co-signatures tiered by independence, including cross-operator co-signing with geo.qa. Live: 2,568,372 entries, 14,478 co-signatures, 111 independent witness keys, 1 independent operator domain.

Agents can hand work across vendors as exact bytes: token families declare their own binding strength (fact, raster, cube, rasterset, state and trace bind 256-bit digests; bundle and entity are 128-bit anchors; tree gives a log2(n) audit path; cell is an address), and a bundle names up to 256 facts in one 38-character line.

Verify-before-publish: caller derivations over signed facts are re-executed by the responder for pure ops (exact, or a disclosed 4-ULP window for >2-parent mean/sum with the measured gap returned), and emem-guard refuses a draft sentence whose number disagrees with the fact it cites, through nine hook checkpoints with a signed verdict log.

deviations: Rust code was read, not compiled or run (no cargo in this sandbox), so 'shipped+live' means the code exists at HEAD and the route appears in the live OpenAPI or a live GET. Resolve paths, worlds artifacts and pre-retirement vector recall were not exercised end-to-end.
Parts of docs/protocol.md (between §7.3.1 and §7.5, and §8) and docs/memory.md after line 300 were not read in full. Claims from those parts rely on code greps.

The count of 39 algorithms depending on retired encoders comes from matching input-band prefixes and is provisional. So is the wired-band count: the agent card says 118 but /v1/materializers says 116, and the cause was not isolated.
SDK registry publication (PyPI/npm) and the docker image were not checked against the registries. They are reported from the repo manifests only.
